Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Concurrent Medication: Allowed: - Procrit. - Amphotericin B (1 mg/kg up to 5 days/week). - Prophylaxis treatment as per ACTG recommendations for Pneumocystis carinii pneumonia. - Acyclovir (up to 1000 mg/day PO; for > 1000 mg/day PO or for any IV dose, suggest interrupting ddC). - Ketoconazole (up to 10 mg/kg/day). - Nystatin. - Aspirin, acetaminophen, sedatives, and barbiturates (for up to 72 hours). - Isoniazid (INH), if there is no evidence of peripheral neuropathy at entry. Children should receive pyridoxine, 25 - 50 mg/day to avoid possible INH-associated neuropathy. - Trimethoprim / sulfamethoxazole (T/S). - Immunoglobulin therapy. - Aerosolized pentamidine. - Drugs with little nephro-, hepato-, cytotoxicity that the patient has been taking and tolerating well for an ongoing condition.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient is on atorvastatin and metformin, both of which are allowed as they have minimal nephrotoxicity and are tolerated well.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Concurrent Treatment: Allowed: - Immunoglobulin therapy. - Nutritional support (for children with wasting syndrome and/or malnutritional) including hyperalimentation (TPN) of dietary supplements.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient is an adult with no indication of wasting syndrome or malnutrition.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: AMENDED: - Patients enrolled in ACTG 051 may participate in ACTG 138 if they show intolerance to AZT or show disease progression after 6 months of AZT therapy and meet entry criteria for the study.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient is not enrolled in ACTG 051 or mentioned to have AZT intolerance/disease progression.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patients must have the following: - Absence of acute opportunistic infection at time of entry. - However, if patient is successfully treated for opportunistic infection and has remained stable for 2 weeks after treatment, the patient is then allowed to enter the study. Children receiving maintenance therapy for > 4 weeks are eligible.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No evidence of acute opportunistic infection; patient has no history of such infections requiring treatment.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Parent or guardian available to give written informed consent.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Written informed consent has been obtained from the patient or legal representative.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Allowed at time of study entry: - Prophylaxis treatment as per ACTG recommendations, for Pneumocystis carinii pneumonia (PCP). - Immunoglobulin therapy.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No indication of PCP prophylaxis or immunoglobulin therapy required.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Prior Medication: AMENDED: - AZT or ddI up until study entry, other antiretrovirals up until 4 weeks of study entry Allowed: - Zidovudine (AZT) within 4 weeks of entry. - Dideoxyinosine (ddI) within 43 weeks of entry if no peripheral neuropathy has been observed while receiving ddI. - Other toxicities observed while on ddI must resolve to level 2 or better before patient can begin treatment with ddC. - Vitamin, folate, iron supplements.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient is not on AZT/ddI or other antiretrovirals, and is on vitamin/metformin, which are allowed.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Co-existing Condition: AMENDED: - 04-25-91 Additional excluded symptoms and conditions: - Symptomatic cardiomyopathy.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient has ischemic cardiomyopathy, a co-existing condition explicitly excluded.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: - Seizures which are not well controlled by ongoing anticonvulsant therapy.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No mention of seizures or anticonvulsant therapy.
No evidence of active malignancy or chemotherapy.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: - Grade I or greater peripheral neuropathy.
- Patients with the following conditions or symptoms are excluded: - Acute bacterial infections requiring IV or oral antibiotic treatment at time of entry.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No evidence of acute bacterial infections requiring antibiotics.
No mention of hypersensitivity to ddC.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: - Active opportunistic infection requiring treatment with an excluded concomitant medication.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No evidence of active opportunistic infection requiring excluded medications.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Prior Medication: Excluded: - Antiretroviral agents (other than zidovudine (AZT) or didanosine (ddI)) within 4 weeks of entry.
- Immunomodulating agents such as interferons, isoprinosine, or interleukin-2 within 2 weeks of entry.
- Any other experimental therapy, drugs that cause prolonged neutropenia, significant nephrotoxicity, or peripheral neuropathy within 1 week of entry.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient is on atorvastatin and metformin, which do not meet exclusion criteria.

Recap: Patient has symptomatic cardiomyopathy, which is an exclusion criterion. Other criteria are met or irrelevant.
